The '''Ayanee Farming Cluster''' was a cluster of six [[silvergrass]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The cluster was lead by [[Tayala Lees]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
